speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: Currently being treated for community-acquired pneumonia. No other significant past medical history. Social history: Non-smoker, does not consume alcohol. No recent travel or dietary changes reported.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the negative C. diff tests and lack of other risk factors, this is likely antibiotic-associated diarrhea secondary to levofloxacin. I will manage this supportively with hydration and consider discontinuing the antibiotic if clinically appropriate. REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal_CT
